name: blueprint/skill-authoring
description: Author a packaged dsh skill: frontmatter drives catalog search, the body is the reference, registration is ctx.skills, shipping is the plugin release
recipe: write the frontmatter (name + description first - it drives search) -> write the body as a reference, not a tutorial -> register via ctx.skills on mount -> gate, ship, install
pitfalls: the description is what the catalog matches - write it for search
the body is a reference: tool tables, semantics, limits
a skill that restates tools without guidance is noise
